King's Cake
https://www.allrecipes.com/recipe/8144/mardi-gras-king-cake/
https://www.bettycrocker.com/recipes/quick-mardi-gras-king-cake/a285aa15-62d7-493b-8d34-b00038646c81
1. Heat the milk in the saucepan, then remove it from the heat and add the butter.
2. Add the sugar and yeast to the water and whisk.
3. Add the milk mixture to the yeast mixture and mix. Then whisk in the eggs, sugar, salt, and nutmeg.
4. Knead the dough on the countertop. Then pour oil into the bowl and place the dough in. We'll leave it to rise.
5. To make the filling, combine the brown sugar, cinnamon, pecans, flour, and raisins. Pour the melted butter overtop and mix.
6. Cut the dough and roll out each half. Sprinkle the filling over each and roll them up. Place each on the baking sheet.
7. Open up the oven and place the cake in.
8. Combine the powdered sugar, milk, and vanilla in the mixer.
9. Open up the oven and take out the cake. Pour the icing overtop, then add the purple, green, and gold sprinkles.

Beignets
https://bakerbynature.com/new-orleans-style-beignets/
1. Add the sugar and yeast to the warm water and whisk well.
2. Beat the eggs in the mixer. Beat in the vanilla, evaporated milk, and flour. Add the yeast mixture and beat.
3. Add the butter and mix. Finally, add the flour and salt and mix once more. Cover the bowl with plastic wrap.
4. After the dough has risen for a while, roll it out and cut it into rectangles.
5. Heat the oil in the pot. Add a few of the dough rectangles to fry them.
6. Remove the beignets from the oil using the tongs.
7. Dust the beignets with powdered sugar.

Hush Puppies
https://therecipecritic.com/homemade-hush-puppies/#wprm-recipe-container-98913
https://www.wideopeneats.com/recipes/hush-puppies-cajun-dipping-sauce/
1. Mix together the flour, cornmeal, sugar, baking powder, salt, garlic powder, onion powder, paprika, and pepper.
2. Add the egg and buttermilk to the dry ingredients and stir. Then add the butter and stir again.
3. Heat the oil in the pot. Then drop spoonful's of batter into the pot to fry.
4. Remove the hush puppies from the oil and set them on the baking sheet to drip out the excess oil.
5. Combine the sour cream, lemon, honey, and spice mix. This makes a nice dipping sauce.

Shrimp and Grits
https://chefsavvy.com/creamy-shrimp-grits/
1. Boil and milk and chicken broth in the saucepan. Then add the grits and whisk. Lower the heat.
2. Take the pot off the heat. Whisk in salt, pepper, butter, and cheese.
3. Add the bacon to the pan and turn on the heat. Once it's cooked, set the bacon on the plate.
4. Melt the butter on the warm pan. Add the shrimp and cook them. Then add the garlic and stir them a bit.
5. Remove the shrimp from the pan. Add wine to deglaze the pan. Stir in the lemon juice, shrimp, and bacon bits.
6. To plate, add some of the grits to the bowl and top with the shrimp mixture. Sprinkle green onions on top.

Shrimp and Sausage Gumbo
https://www.delish.com/cooking/recipe-ideas/a54681/easy-seafood-gumbo-recipe/
1. Chop the onions, pepper, and celery on the cutting board.
2. Melt the butter in the pan. Then add the flour and stir continuously until the roux turns dark.
3. Add the vegetables to the pan and mix well. Then add the garlic and sausage and stir some more.
4. Season with cajun seasoning, salt, pepper, and bay leaf; mixing well. Add the diced tomatoes and chicken broth and stir.
5. Once it's boiling, turn down the heat to a simmer. It'll simmer for about an hour.
6. Add water and rice to the rice cooker. Press the button to turn it on and let it cook.
7. Add the shrimp to the pan and let it cook. Then stir in the green onions.
8. Add some of the rice to the dish. Then pour the gumbo overtop. Top with more green onions.

Crawfish Dip
https://www.southernliving.com/syndication/crawfish-dip
1. Chop the onions, pepper, celery, and jalapeño on the cutting board.
2. Melt the butter in the pan. Add the vegetables, salt, and pepper and mix.
3. Add the paprika and cayenne pepper and mix some more.
4. Place the crawfish, cream cheese, and cheddar cheese, into the slow cooker. 5. Stir in the vegetable mixture, mustard, Worcestershire sauce, and hot sauce. Cover the pot to cook for about an hour.
6. Mix in the lemon juice and parsley. Then plate with the crackers.
